newsitem.title: USA: American Air says discussions will continue.
newsitem.headline: American Air says discussions will continue.

text.p: American Airlines on Tuesday said it would hold further discussions with the European Commission and the U.S. and British governments over its proposed alliance with British Airways Plc.

"Media reports that the European Commission wants changes to the American Airlines-British Airways alliance -- as currently proposed -- are not terribly surprising, since European Commission officials have previously made public comments along those lines," American, a unit of AMR Corp, said in a media release.

European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert on Tuesday met in London with officials of the new British government. The Commission declined official comment, but EU sources said they expected Van Miert to reiterate the Commission's opposition to the proposed AMR-BA alliance as it now stands.

"Both airlines have been negotiating with the U.K. government since last fall to address concerns, and we have laid out conditions by which we are prepared to abide," American said. "We view all this as part of the approval process, and will continue our discussions with the European Union and the other U.S. and U.K. governmental authorities."
British Airways said earlier Tuesday it would meet with European Commission officials "as soon as possible" to discuss the alliance.
